text:
maria: FYI discovered a public gist that includes a partner webhook payload JSON with an `encrypted_blob` and a header `wrapped_key: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/transit/cryptoKeys/partner-wrap`. Looks like a wrapped ciphertext leak. I've removed the gist link.
incident-bot: Generated incident INC-2026-0427. Evidence copied to secure bucket: gs://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-0427/.
jordan: Good catch. Can you paste the object path and any sample fragments (redact tokens)? Need to size impact.
maria: Object: gs://partner-logs/webhooks/2026-03-21/payload.json. Inside I see `encrypted_blob` and nearby plaintext matching pattern `ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}` in the payload metadata. Also saw `gitlab-ci-token:` strings.
leo: Treat as compromised. Immediate checklist: (1) disable partner SA, (2) snapshot affected objects, (3) lock down bucket ACLs, (4) rotate the KMS wrapping key, (5) rewrap ciphertexts to new key, (6) rotate exposed tokens & CI creds.
ops-oncall: Disabling partner service account now and adding temporary bucket ACL denying public access. I'll also add a deny VPC egress rule for the partner cluster.
ops-oncall: partner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com disabled at 13:04 UTC. Bucket public access revoked.
jordan: Maria/Leo please include quick runnable commands to search for other occurrences and to rewrap so ops can run them.
maria: Cloud Logging query to find Vault transit unwraps and KMS decrypts:
```
gcloud logging read "resource.type=global AND (protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt\" OR protoPayload.methodName=\"vault.transit.unwrap\") AND timestamp>\"2026-03-19T00:00:00Z\"" --project=redwood-prod --limit=2000
```
And a fast grep across backups (may be heavy):
```
gsutil -m cat gs://partner-logs/** | grep -E --line-number "ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}|gitlab-ci-token|encrypted_blob"
```
leo: Rewrap plan (example):
```
# copy object locally
gsutil cp gs://partner-logs/webhooks/2026-03-21/payload.json /tmp/payload.json

# run rewrap tool (internal)
./bin/rewrap --in /tmp/payload.json --from-key=partner-wrap --to-key=prod-locked-2026 --out /tmp/payload.rewrapped.json

# upload back
gsutil cp /tmp/payload.rewrapped.json gs://partner-logs/webhooks/2026-03-21/payload.json.rewrapped
```
ops-oncall: Starting snapshot + rewrap jobs. I'll also apply a temporary IAM deny binding on vault transit unwraps for all non-infra SAs. Need explicit approval from security to change vault RBAC in prod.
jordan: Approve temporary deny binding for up to 8 hours for the transit/unwrap method. Security to be notified. Make sure change is audited and reversible.
incident-bot: Assignments: @ops-oncall (snapshot + rewrap run), @leo (sweep script + rewrap tool), @maria (rotations for CI tokens + partner comms), @jordan (RBAC approval + incident comms). Target mitigation window: 6 hours.
maria: Starting rotation for discovered GH tokens. Will coordinate app owners for GitLab tokens. PR to partner runbook to add pre-commit blocklist for external paste/gist links: https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/pull/459

leo: Sweep results: found 5 matching blobs referencing the partner-wrap key across partner-logs and archived backups. Kicking off rewrap operations now, logs sent to incident bucket under rewrap-logs/.

ops-oncall: Rewrap job status: 5/5 rewrapped, checksums validated, uploaded to gs://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-0427/rewrap-logs/. Took ~18 minutes.
jordan: Enable short-term audit export of Vault logs + Cloud KMS admin logs to the incident bucket; grant security-team read access and set retention 90d.
maria: Confirmed exports and ACLs. Added security-team@redwood as readers.

leo: Post-actions: rotate wrapping key to projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/transit/cryptoKeys/prod-locked-2026, revoke old key's cryptoKeyVersions, update key policy to restrict use to infra SAs only, and schedule KMS key rotation.
jordan: Please capture all changes in the incident timeline. Maria/Leo — postmortem owners?
maria: Happy to lead with Leo. We'll include timeline, root cause (partner pushed gist containing a webhook dump), remediation (SA disable, bucket lock, rewrap, token rotation, RBAC tighten), and follow-ups (contract clause for ephemeral wrapping keys, CI scanning, partner onboarding checklist).
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0427 status -> mitigated. Severity P2. Postmortem assigned to maria and leo. Due 2026-03-28.
maria: Thanks team. I'll set up a 30m sync with the partner infra team to review their key management and CI hygiene. :thumbsup:
